title: Phone banned-word list lacks the "Your keys" exception; unused var warning in efficiency.rs
body: From #10287 (d00a492fbc): `crates/coder/src/router/gym.rs` now allows the bring-your-own-keys names ("Your keys", "Your own keys", "Use my keys") while still banning other keys. The phone keeps its own copy of the banned words in `crates/openagents-chat-app/src/eval_cards.rs` without that exception — share one list (or mirror it with a test that they match). Also fix the unused `base` warning at `crates/coder/src/efficiency.rs:391`.
